notCovered: validation of yoga poses or human tissue parameters
scope.referenceOutput: The geometry inputs below are transcribed from the publication. The length/moment-arm samples are independently derived analytic values, not the authors' supplementary simulation results.

source.title: Validation of skeletal muscle models in multibody dynamics: A collaborative collection of benchmark cases
source.issueYearNote: The current publisher article page lists volume 66, pages 1057–1100 (2026); the downloaded version-of-record PDF header prints (2025). The unambiguous online publication date above is used for source provenance.
source.attribution: Geometry adapted from Tables 1, 2, 3 and 5 of Gonçalves et al.; analytic geometry references and FYSM segment mapping added. No published human model or tissue calibration is implied.

tableLocations.used: body-local joint positions and revolute axis
initial body centers, orientations and rounded body-2 velocities
Case 1 and Case 2 origin, insertion and via-point coordinates; reference-length parameters retained only as metadata

transcriptionNotes: Coordinates are body-local metres with the body frame at its center of mass; the initial body orientations are identity.
Case 2 extensor via-point z is -0.450 m, not -0.500 m. This makes its fixed first segment 0.950 m.
Table-5 l_ref_MT is a contraction-model parameter. It is not the exact geometric neutral path length in Case 2.
Table-5 f0_M has an apparent unit-label inconsistency with the force nomenclature. No force-capacity entries are imported or used here.

The printed initial angular rate -1.6447 rad/s is not exactly -(pi/6)*pi for a literal 30-degree, 2-second sinusoid. Only the internal consistency of the printed instantaneous velocities is checked, not an exact author time waveform.
The introductory fixed-at-CoM wording differs from Table 2 and section 4.1. This fixture uses the explicit joint coordinates and initial centers in Tables 2 and 3.

units.signedMomentArm: m, equal to -dL/dq for a right-hand +Y rotation
units.probeTension: N; test-selected, not a published force result

adaptation.meaning: Segment names only adapt the actual FYSM point-transform and ownership APIs to this published synthetic two-body geometry; no anatomical pose, attachment or parameter is changed.
adaptation.worldMapping: W[mappedSegment].p = published body center; W[mappedSegment].q = body rotation
adaptation.physicsHelperMapping: Use the existing elbow moved-subtree with the explicitly supplied benchmark +Y axis and published J1 center; this does not test the anatomical elbow-axis definition.

analyticReference.provenance: Independently computed with scalar Python math from the transcribed coordinates; not sampled from FYSM or the authors' plots.
analyticReference.formula: For the final segment, r = insertionLocal - J1.body2Local, a = lastFixedLocal - J1.body1Local. b(q) = Ry(q) r, s = b-a. L(q) = fixedPolylineLength + norm(s); dL/dq = dot(s, [b.z, 0, -b.x])/norm(s); momentArm = -dL/dq.
